review_planner.summary: The changes introduce new features to the embed modal component, including options to hide the avatar and select a locale, which affects the iframe source URL generation.

tasks.title: Security Review
tasks.description: Verify that the iframe source URL generation does not introduce any security vulnerabilities, such as open redirect or injection attacks. Ensure that the `generateIframeSrc` function properly encodes parameters and validates inputs.

tasks.title: Logic Review
tasks.description: Ensure that the new state variables (`visibleAvatar`, `locale`) and their respective handlers (`setVisibleAvatar`, `setLocale`) are correctly implemented and integrated into the component. Verify that the `generateIframeSrc` function accurately constructs the iframe URL based on the current state.

tasks.title: Performance Review
tasks.description: Assess the impact of the new features on performance, particularly the additional state management and URL generation logic. Ensure that the component remains responsive and efficient.

tasks.title: General Review
tasks.description: Check for any user-facing behavior changes, broken integration contracts, or meaningful missing tests related to the new features. Ensure that the new translations and locale options are correctly integrated and used.

worker_reports.context_summary: The changes introduce new features for embedding a modal with options to hide the avatar and select a locale. The review focuses on user-facing behavior, integration consistency, test coverage, and documentation.
warnings: The diff does not provide enough context to determine if there are any broken integration contracts or if the new translations and locale options are fully integrated and used consistently across the application.

worker_reports.context_summary: The review focuses on the correctness, behavioral regressions, and API contract mismatches introduced by the new state variables (`visibleAvatar`, `locale`) and their respective handlers (`setVisibleAvatar`, `setLocale`). The `generateIframeSrc` function is also verified for accurate URL construction.
warnings: No direct evidence of backward compatibility issues or severe defects was found. However, further testing should be conducted to ensure that the new features do not introduce unintended side effects.

worker_reports.context_summary: No significant performance regressions or scalability risks were identified in the provided changes.
warnings: The code includes repeated string concatenation in the `generateIframeSrc` function, which could be slightly optimized by using template literals or an array join method. However, given the small number of parameters and the infrequent nature of this operation, it does not constitute a performance issue.

worker_reports.context_summary: No concrete security issues were found in the provided code changes.
warnings: The `generateIframeSrc` function constructs the iframe source URL by concatenating user-provided inputs (`token`, `form`, `beta`, `visibleAvatar`, `locale`) without explicit encoding. While this might not immediately lead to a security vulnerability, it could potentially be exploited if these inputs are not properly sanitized or encoded elsewhere in the application. Ensure that these inputs are encoded to prevent injection attacks.
